posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
This is one of the most complete quest system plugins I’ve seen for RPG Maker, comparable to the best from the XP/Ace era.
MZ really lacks solutions like this, especially something so well documented, flexible, and scalable.
The result offers a good balance between technical control and practical usability.
Thanks you sharing.
